article.story: BEAUMONT, Texas -- — Ja'Sean Jackson had 15 points to lead Lamar to a 67-56 victory over Texas A&M-Corpus Christi on Monday night. Jackson shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the free-throw line for the Cardinals (15-10, 10-4 Southland Conference). Andrew Holifield added 13 points and five rebounds. Alexis Marmolejos had 13 points and three steals. Owen Dease led the way for the Islanders (15-11, 8-6) with 20 points. Jaden Walker had nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
